PlannedItem.description:
One URL that survived deduplication and was chosen for the day.

`item_id` is derived from `url_key`, so the same article carries the same
id on every run of every day. `published_at` is the time the run believes -
the feed's own date, unless it claimed a future too far ahead to be true,
in which case it is when we first saw the address. `time_source` says which
of the two it is.

`rank_score` is the number the day is ordered on, and the eight terms under
it are what it was built from: `authority_score` plus `carriage_step` plus
`watchlist_bonus` plus `lens_bonus` plus `recency_bonus` is `rank_score`,
and `tier_score` times `feed_weight` times `feed_reliability` is
`authority_score`. Every one of the thirteen score fields is null on a plan
written before 2026-09-14 - unknown, and never a term worth nothing.

authority_score.description: The best-trusted feed that carried this story, scored: its tier score times its own weight times its reliability. The largest term of the score, and the only one that is a product rather than a step.
authority_score.title: Authority Score

canonical_url.description: After canonicalisation. url_key derives from it.
canonical_url.title: Canonical Url

carriage_step.description: collect.carriage_step when more than one feed carried this address, and 0.0 when one did. A flat step that fires once, never a count.
carriage_step.title: Carriage Step

carried_by.description: Independent feeds that carried this story today.
carried_by.title: Carried By

dual_score.description: The pair of readings a two-axis story is scored on. No producer yet - null until the known-defects work writes it.
dual_score.title: Dual Score

feed_reliability.description: That feed's factor from the trailing feed-health window, built once per run by ledger.reliability. 1.0 means no recent evidence against it.
feed_reliability.title: Feed Reliability

feed_weight.description: That feed's own weight from config/sources.json. Soft retirement.
feed_weight.title: Feed Weight

fit_weight.description: How well the chosen chart form fits the data it draws. No producer yet - null until the visual planning work writes it.
fit_weight.title: Fit Weight

label_confidence.description: How sure the label call was of what this article is about. No producer yet - declared so the row shape stops moving, and null until the article-classification work writes it.
label_confidence.title: Label Confidence

lens_bonus.description: The weight of the one lens this story earned most from, matched on the headline. Never the sum of several, and 0.0 when no lens matched.
lens_bonus.title: Lens Bonus

null_score.description: What this story scores against the no-visual baseline. No producer yet - null until the known-defects work writes it.
null_score.title: Null Score

on_front_page.description: A salience feed voted for it. A vote, never a discovery.
on_front_page.title: On Front Page

recency_bonus.description: collect.recency_weight decayed by age at plan time. Orders what the age gate already admitted; it never admits anything itself.
recency_bonus.title: Recency Bonus

relationship_score.description: How well the picture a run planned matches the relationship the article states. No producer yet - null until the visual planning work writes it.
relationship_score.title: Relationship Score

source_form.description: Declared feed form, carried from config so workers never infer it.

source_id.description: The feed that carried it first.
source_id.title: Source Id

source_url.description: The address as the feed gave it.
source_url.title: Source Url

tier_score.description: collect.tier_weights for that feed's tier. From the same feed that won authority_score, never from another carrier of the story.
tier_score.title: Tier Score

time_source.description: Which clock published_at came from. Null on a plan written before the field existed - unknown, and never a claim about a clock.

watchlist_bonus.description: collect.watchlist_bonus when watchlist_hit, and 0.0 when not.
watchlist_bonus.title: Watchlist Bonus

PlannedItem.title: PlannedItem

PublishedAgeBand.description:
How many refused addresses fall in one band of days since publication.

A count on its own says the guard fired. It cannot say whether a cover of a
given width would have let any of those addresses through, and that is what
the width of the cover turns on - so the bands are recorded beside the count.

Every declared band is written, including the empty ones. A band that is
absent and a band holding nothing are different answers, and only one of
them is a measurement.

addresses.description: Distinct addresses the guard refused in this band.
addresses.title: Addresses

to_days.description: Exclusive upper edge, in days. Null on the open-ended oldest band.
to_days.title: To Days

PublishedAgeBand.title: PublishedAgeBand

SourceTier.description: The tier IS the ranking weight (docs/architecture/sources/discovery.md).
SourceTier.title: SourceTier

TimeSource.description:
Which clock the time on an item came from.

`rank.appeared_at` prefers the feed's own date and falls back to when we
first saw the address. Both answers used to land in one field, so nothing
downstream could tell them apart - and the fallback is the one a reader
would want flagged, because it is our clock and not the publisher's.
TimeSource.title: TimeSource

VerticalPlan.description: Why a vertical contributed what it did, including when it contributed nothing.

below_feed_floor.description: Under its floor, so it is collected but never rendered.
below_feed_floor.title: Below Feed Floor

eligible_feeds.description: Feeds on this desk whose configured address this run may lawfully ask: not a curated tombstone, not a retired endpoint, and not one robots.txt refused or left unknown. A resting or failing endpoint is counted, because the floor measures how many independent sources a desk has rather than how many answered today.
eligible_feeds.title: Eligible Feeds

feed_floor.description: The vertical's own min_feeds this count was measured against, so a payload can be read without the config that produced it. Null on a plan written before the field existed - unknown, never a floor of zero.
feed_floor.title: Feed Floor

too_old.description: Of those considered, how many were past collect.max_age_hours. A desk whose feeds serve a back catalogue thins for this reason and no other, and a thin desk that cannot say why reads as a broken run.
too_old.title: Too Old

VerticalPlan.title: VerticalPlan

changelog.change: A planned item carries the eight terms that add up to rank_score.
changelog.why: Only the total survived, so nobody could read why a story ranked where it did.

changelog.change: item_id accepts a second shape: sixteen Crockford base32 symbols.
changelog.why: Ten decimal digits is 33 bits of an address, which collides on a busy day.

changelog.change: A run records what the already-published guard refused on dropped_published.
changelog.why: The guard is the whole reason the published ledger is read entire.

changelog.change: live_feeds on a vertical is renamed eligible_feeds and feed_floor is added.
changelog.why: The count decided whether a desk publishes and counted the wrong feeds.

changelog.change: Earlier changes are in this file's git history.
changelog.why: A changelog says what moved lately; git is the archive.

description: What the plan job decided, before a single byte of an article was fetched.

dropped_published.description: Distinct addresses this run collected on a desk it plans and then refused, because the published ledger already holds them. Null on a plan written before the field existed - unknown, and never a run where the guard refused nothing.
dropped_published.title: Dropped Published

dropped_published_ages.description: How old those addresses were, cut on PUBLISHED_AGE_BANDS. Every band is written, so a zero here is a measured zero. Null exactly when dropped_published is.
dropped_published_ages.title: Dropped Published Ages

feeds_skipped.description: Never asked this run: resting out a quarantine, or configured at an address the retirement ledger holds. Neither read nor failed.
feeds_skipped.title: Feeds Skipped

stale.description: Discovery failed and an earlier list was reused. Never skip a day silently.
stale.title: Stale
